name: goHELLgo Tsukiotoshiteko
original_name: ゴーヘルゴー つきおとしてこ
source:
The story is set in Hell, and sees our protagonist, an oni named 8246 (Yatsushiro) making ends meet as a guide for the departed. That changes one day when he meets Tomori, a recently deceased girl. With her, he stages an outrageous plan to break out of poverty at all costs. But the chaos the two end up unleashing in their ill-fated get-rich-quick scheme threatens to shake the very foundation of Hell itself...

[Translated from the official [url=https://www.entergram.co.jp/gohellgo/#sec-story]website[/url] by [url=https://x.com/DistantValhalla/status/1727439585175834811]Steiner[/url]]
translation:
故事以地狱为舞台，主人公是名为8246（八代）的鬼，平时靠引渡亡者勉强糊口度日。直到某一天，他邂逅了刚刚离世的少女灯里，平淡穷困的生活由此迎来转折。为了无论如何都要摆脱贫困，他与灯里联手策划了一场荒诞离奇的惊天奇谋。然而，两人这场注定多舛的一夜暴富计划所引发的混乱，最终竟演变成足以动摇地狱根基的大风波…
